title: Migration Hub
introduction: Your centralized platform for managing migrations across IBM Cloud products and services. It identifies the resources in your account that require action, helps you plan your migration path, and guides you through each step — with instructions, documentation, and tools for transitions.

section_highlights.title: Migrating from Classic Infrastructure to VPC
section_highlights.description: Learn how to transition your workloads from IBM Cloud Classic Infrastructure to Virtual Private Cloud for enhanced security and performance.

tiles.title: Centralized migration tracking and status monitoring
